limitations:
Compare the same baseline-selected windows, including estimator phase sensitivity.
Synthetic envelopes are empirical checks, NOT rigorous bounds on unknown motion.
They omit executor segmentation, step correction, motor mechanics and probe errors.
windows: Chosen from baseline sensitivity checks and retained unchanged for fixed measurements. .01mm unresolved.
time_note: Measured time is first-to-last step only; step correction/start phase changes can shift it substantially for short moves. Ideal command-to-rest durations are model predictions, not measurements.
